rust_summary: the scoreboard: a score read for any objective, a score written, an objective created or removed only in the mod's own `<mod_id>.<name>` namespace.
doc_summary: `scoreboard_score(holder, objective)` reads any objective's score (`None` when missing); `scoreboard_set_score`, `scoreboard_add_score` (saturating), `scoreboard_add_objective` and `scoreboard_remove_objective` write only the mod's own `<mod_id>.<name>` objectives and return `false` when refused; `scoreboard_objectives` lists every objective. Bundles need "hooks": @API:scoreboard@.
